complete_video_analysis.limitations: Automatic timing may use embedded media clocks; check against real source duration. Catalog labels may be mismatched; prefer actual preview when verified.

scenes.audio: A male voice says in a deep, composed tone: 'Then let me show you the effect of this dialogue.'
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A static wide shot of a desktop web browser interface. The background is a clean, minimalist white workspace. On the left side, a sidebar displays a navigation menu with list items. The center area contains text blocks and bullet points in Chinese characters. A speech bubble appears at the top right. A digital cursor moves across the screen. The lighting is bright and even, simulating a backlit computer monitor. The color palette is dominated by whites and light grays with occasional accents of green.

scenes.audio: A digital 'click' sound effect coincides with the cursor action, followed by a subtle, low-frequency ambient hum.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: The camera quickly zooms in and pans to the left sidebar of the application interface. The cursor hovers over a folder icon and then clicks on a specific list item. The item highlights briefly upon the click. The focus is sharp on the text and icons, with soft artificial lighting consistent with a screen recording. The movement is smooth and precise.

scenes.audio: The ambient electronic hum continues at a low volume. No spoken words.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The camera pans right to the main content area of the browser. A new section of text and a list of bullet points are revealed. The cursor moves down the page, highlighting the 'Direct play of WeChat dialogue MP4' section. The background remains a sterile white, and the text is crisp black and blue. The scroll movement is steady and intentional.

scenes.audio: A distinct mechanical 'click' sound plays as the selection is made, followed by a short, rising melodic chime to signify a successful action.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: The camera zooms in tightly on the bottom center of the interface. A dropdown menu labeled 'Switch Model' is visible. The cursor moves to a model selection pill that reads 'GPT-6.1 Sol'. The cursor clicks the selection, and the button pulse-animates. The colors are high contrast, featuring white text on a dark background within the selection UI. The lighting focuses purely on the interactive elements.
